content:
Rohan: Heads-up  new Senior ML Infra starts Mon 9am PT. Need a compact week0 plan, a candidate one-pager for the offer, and a manager 30/60/90 checklist. Maya can you spin up a quick draft?
Maya: Yep. Quick checks: buddy confirmed? laptop imaging? NDA gating for datasets?
Ellen: I can buddy mornings 9:15-9:45 for first 2 weeks. IT says imaging possible Fri if asset tag sent today. Legal flagged NDA for datasets.
it-team: Ticket created: #13123 (laptop image + Okta + GH invite). Owner: infra.
Maya: Proposed ultra-lean week0 (micro-sprint style):
Mon AM: 20m welcome + accounts handoff, quick Slack intro
Mon PM: 30m team demo + env pairing (buddy)
Tue: code tour + assign 1 micro-task (README + tiny test)
Wed: observability/runbooks + NDA check (30m)
Thu: deploy path + smoke canary with buddy (30m)
Fri: 30m manager sync + buddy retro + next steps
Maya: Pre-provision checklist to infra: laptop image, Okta, Slack invite, GH org membership, CI write, k8s namespace + canary-only SA, read-only prod metrics + Grafana share, Redwood Console dev access.
Rohan: For the candidate one-pager keep it 3 bullets per 30/60/90 and top 3 contacts (buddy, manager, infra). Also add NDA link and a one-line about first-week micro-tasks.
Maya: Draft candidate blurb (one paragraph):
"Welcome! In your first 30 days we expect your dev environment set up and 12 small PRs merged; by 60 days you should be running a non-peak canary deploy and participating in incident playbooks; by 90 days youll be independently deploying and present a short perf/cost improvement. Buddy: Ellen (mornings), Manager: Rohan. Please sign the NDA (link) to unlock dataset access"
Maya: Manager 30/60/90 (concise checklist):
- Week0: confirm accounts + laptop, daily 15m check-ins, assign 3 micro-tasks with explicit acceptance criteria, ensure NDA gating noted.
- 30d: env stable, >=2 PRs merged (one test + one doc), buddy feedback collected, manager posts formative note.
- 60d: owns one service deploy (canary), demonstrates incident-debug steps, contributes to observability ticket.
- 90d: independent deploys, leads a 15-20m tech update with metrics-backed improvement, and a plan for next quarter.
Rohan: Add "Manager quick tips": reserve 15m daily week0, be explicit about acceptance criteria, schedule end-of-week 30m review, and collect buddy feedback in writing.
people-ops-bot: Onboarding packet created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1881234567
Ellen: I'll confirm calendar invites for pairing and attach a short "how to run tests" doc.
Rohan: Perfect. Maya, please post final one-pager + manager doc here by EOD and I'll sign off for hiring manager to send. :thumbsup:
